transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well… mostly it’s that I don’t seem to take things in when people talk to me. My wife will be telling me something, like about my cousin’s appointments or rides, and I’m looking right at her, but then a minute later I realize I missed half of it.
Do you find it hard to focus or concentrate on things, even when you’re trying to pay attention?

Yes… I think so. Like, if I’m trying to work through a catering order, or sit through one of the parish planning calls, I start out paying attention. But after a while my mind just drifts, and then I’m looking back over the same notes like I didn’t really read them the first time.
Have you been feeling down, depressed, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?
I don’t think so… not really. I mean, I have my off days, but I haven’t noticed anything like that.
Do you find that you lose track of conversations or tasks more often than you used to, even when you’re making a real effort to stay focused?

Yes… I’d say so. If I’m working on a catering order or sitting through a parish planning call, I’ll start off okay, but then my mind wanders. I end up going back over the same notes like I never really read them.
Do you find that you forget things more often than before, like appointments, where you put things, or whether you’ve done something?

Yeah… a little. I’ve missed things I meant to do, like calling the doctor’s office back, or picking up a prescription. And sometimes I cut it too close leaving for my cousin’s appointment. It’s not constant, but it’s been happening.
Have these memory or attention problems been getting in the way of your daily activities, like managing your work or family responsibilities?

Some, yeah. It’s not… ruining everything, but it’s caused some friction at home. My wife gets frustrated, like she can’t quite count on me with my cousin’s care. And with the catering stuff, I’ve had to go back and double-check or redo things so little jobs don’t get mixed up.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest or pleasure in most things?
I don’t know… not really in a big way. I’ve had off days, sure, but I wouldn’t say I’ve been hopeless or not enjoying most things.
Have you noticed any days where it felt like you couldn’t get going, or you felt slowed down physically or mentally, even if you weren’t stressed or busy?
Not really that I’ve noticed. I mean, I have slower mornings sometimes, but I usually figure I’m just tired or dragging a bit. I wouldn’t say it’s been a clear thing.
Do you notice that your mind feels 'foggy' or slowed down, especially when you're trying to think or make decisions?
I don’t think so. I mean, I get distracted or have to think things through twice sometimes, but “foggy” or slowed down… I wouldn’t really put it that way.
Have you felt more irritable, restless, or had moments where you felt down or discouraged, even if it wasn’t severe or lasted only a short time?
Maybe a little discouraged here and there, but nothing that really sticks. I don’t think I’ve been especially irritable or restless… not more than usual, anyway.
Have there been times when you’ve felt like even small tasks, like making a phone call or organizing something, felt like too much effort?
Not really. I mean, I might put things off, but I don’t think it feels like too much effort exactly. More like I just don’t get around to it sometimes.
Have you had any days recently where you felt down or low, even if it wasn’t bad enough to interfere with your day or last very long?
Not that I can really point to. I mean, everybody has an off day, I guess, but I haven’t noticed feeling down in any real way lately.
Have you felt a lack of energy or felt fatigued even when you haven’t been doing much physically?
No, I don’t think so. I get tired sometimes, but not in a way that seems unusual or out of nowhere.
Have there been times recently when you felt less pleasure or satisfaction from things you usually enjoy, even if it didn't last long or seem serious?
I don’t think so. I still enjoy the usual things about the same, as far as I’ve noticed.
Have you had trouble organizing tasks or activities, or found yourself making careless mistakes more often than before, even when you're trying to be careful?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed it being more than usual, I guess. I try to be careful, and sometimes things get a bit scattered, but… nothing I’d say is clearly worse lately.
Have you found yourself struggling to stay organized or keep track of multiple things at once, even when you're trying your best?
I don’t know… not really more than usual. I mean, I can get a bit mixed up if there’s a lot going on, but I haven’t noticed some big problem with it.

Can you describe what happens when you're trying to focus on something important, like a conversation or a task—does your mind wander easily, and do you find yourself forgetting what you were just thinking about?

Yeah… sometimes. If I’m trying to work out a catering order, or I’m on one of those parish planning calls, I start out following along fine. But after a while my mind sort of drifts, and then I’m looking back at the notes like I didn’t really take them in the first time.
Have you had similar issues with attention or forgetfulness going back to your childhood or adolescence, or is this something that started more recently in adulthood?

I guess it goes back pretty far. In grade school, before I was 12, teachers would tell my parents I was bright, but I’d be daydreaming a lot… leaving homework in my desk, needing reminders to finish my classwork. I don’t know, it was just sort of how I was.
How long have you noticed these problems with your attention and forgetfulness—have they been a consistent part of your life since childhood, or have they gotten noticeably worse in recent years?
It’s been there, I think, for a long time… but it’s been more noticeable, harder to manage, maybe for the last 11 months or so. Since my cousin moved in with us after surgery.

Would you say the problems you're having with attention and forgetfulness now are a clear worsening compared to how you were before your cousin moved in, or have they been about the same as usual for you?
Yeah… I’d say it’s a bit worse than my usual. It’s been noticeably harder these past 11 months or so, since my cousin moved in after the surgery.
